This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="PB" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their stark [[Color/Legends|white]] skin and large statures,<ref name="PB" /> towering over individuals who were nearly 2-[[Meter/Legends|meters]]-tall.<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The species also lacked visible [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]], and their hands ended in fleshy, brown [[Claw/Legends|claws]].<ref name="PB" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species served as the [[Crime lord/Legends|boss]] of a group of [[Thug/Legends|thugs]] known as the [[Coruscant mercenary|Coruscant mercenaries]] who were hired, and failed, to prevent two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from reaching their [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], resulting in said boss' death<ref name="PB" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared<ref name="PB" /> in the [[2000]]<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20000403.html|text=New Games Available Now}}</ref> video game [[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'']].<ref name="PB" />
